Type:

Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> tcode;
Description:
std::uint8_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined tcode (type code)
4 bit header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype IEC68133_IIDC.
The value range for tcode shall be:
0x00...0x0F : valid
0x10...0xFF : not used
For transmission, the value of tcode shall be set to the configured value, if it is not provided by
the application.
Visibility:
protected
